extraction_warnings: No per-participant (sample-level) data were available in the provided text; all extracted values are at study or subgroup (control/pHTN/HTN) level.
Several demographic fields (age, sex, BMI) are referenced only via Additional file 1: Table S1, which was not included in the provided text, so these were marked not_reported.

The 'control' and 'disease' enum fields used surface-form group labels (healthy controls, pre-hypertension, primary hypertension) per instructions rather than snapping to allowed enum values; downstream harmonization should map these.

Animal (germ-free mouse) experiment data were not extracted into sample-level rows since the schema concerns human participant metadata and no explicit instruction was given to include animal subjects.
Batch 1 subgroups ['Control', 'pHTN', 'HTN'] differ from batch 0 ['control', 'pHTN', 'HTN']; kept batch 0.

This is a gut microbiome/hypertension study, not an oncology study; most cancer-specific schema fields (ORR, PFS, RECIST, tumor staging, ECOG, tumor size) are not applicable and were marked not_reported.
FMT donor/recipient role information exists but does not map cleanly to the Control/pHTN/HTN subgroup structure used elsewhere in the paper; marked not_reported for field-level consistency.

Biomarker value field contains classification threshold ranges (used to define disease groups) rather than individual/mean measured values, which were only available in supplementary Table S1 not provided in the text.
Smoker status inferred from exclusion criteria (smokers excluded) rather than explicitly stated as participant characteristic.
Batch 2 returned granularity='study_level', differs from batch 0 ('subgroup_level'); kept batch 0.
Batch 2 subgroups [] differ from batch 0 ['control', 'pHTN', 'HTN']; kept batch 0.
host_species field is enum/singular but paper involves both human subjects and germ-free mouse experiments; by_subgroup used to capture both.

sequencing_platform for the main metagenomic dataset is only described generically as 'Illumina platform' without specifying HiSeq/MiSeq/NovaSeq model; HiSeq was explicitly named only for the 16S sequencing of mouse recipient samples.
study_name and pmid could not be directly extracted from the provided text; both marked not_reported per no-fabrication rule.
